description: Attributed 'Robyn Fuentes' as a named speaker in the Solace Partnership Strategy Plaud recording and included her in the speakers.json as a real attendee. David confirmed Robyn was not present at the meeting.
correction: Robyn Fuentes was not in the meeting. The Plaud auto-ID label should have been flagged as a potential mis-identification rather than accepted and passed through to speakers.json.
systemic_fix: When Plaud auto-IDs a speaker by full name who does not appear on the calendar invite, treat it as suspect — flag it for controller confirmation rather than accepting it as ground truth.
